public.summary: Find who promised to do what in meeting notes — and return nothing when nobody did.
public.goal: Write a prompt that pulls action items out of Lumen meeting notes into [{"owner": "...", "action": "..."}]. If an action has no named owner, owner must be null. If there are no action items, return [].
public.exampleInput: Standup, 3 Sep. Ravi to push the auth fix to staging by Thursday. Nisha will draft the release note once that's in. Backlog grooming moved to Friday.
gradedOn: Output is a JSON array of owner and action
Only real commitments count — not discussion, questions or schedule changes
Owner is null when nobody was named, never guessed
An empty list when there are no action items

tests.input: Standup, 3 Sep. Ravi to push the auth fix to staging by Thursday. Nisha will draft the release note once that's in. Backlog grooming moved to Friday.
Design review, 5 Sep. Long discussion about the empty-state illustration. Team split on whether it needs copy. Someone should test it with the onboarding cohort before we decide.
Retro, 8 Sep. Good sprint overall. The deploy freeze helped. Morale seems better than last month. Nothing blocking.
Sync, 9 Sep. Ravi mentioned the migration script is still flaky. Priya asked whether we'd decided on the rollback window. No decisions taken.
